Guest instruction inventory
===========================

Source: guest.S
Disassembly: guest.disassembly.txt
Architecture selected by Clang: rv64ima_zicsr

Privilege and CSR:
  CSRW MTVEC, CSRW MEPC, CSRW MSTATUS, CSRR MCause, CSRR MEPC, CSRW MEPC
  MRET (initial M-to-S handoff and S-mode SBI return)
  ECALL (one S-mode SBI Base call)
  EBREAK (unexpected-trap sentinel only; not reached on success)

RV64I:
  ADDI, AUIPC, BNE, BNEZ, JAL, JALR, LD, LBU, LI expansions,
  LUI, MV expansion, SB, SD, SLLI, FENCE

RV64M:
  MUL

RV64A:
  AMOADD.D with aqrl ordering bits

Compressed instructions: none; .option norvc and the disassembly uses
four-byte instruction addresses throughout.
Floating-point and vector instructions: none.
Linker relaxation: disabled for compilation and linking.
